commit_message: Add stable Humanoid package lookup path
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0110 humanoid profiles, portable Humanoid motion, typed Animation Set sources, and target bake/package resolution.

This request adds a stable-ID package lookup name so shipped playback can load a pre-baked Humanoid clip without reimporting or solving source motion at runtime.
